meta_description: Edge Plumbing and Heating in Wolverhampton. Emergency plumbing, boiler repairs, and heating installations. Same-day service. Call 07875 901866.
hero_subhead: Burst pipes, boiler breakdowns, leaks? We're out to you in under an hour, day or night.
services_heading: Complete Plumbing & Heating Services Across Wolverhampton
services_subhead: From emergency burst pipes to full central heating overhauls, we handle domestic and light commercial work.

services.title: Emergency Plumbing
services.desc: Burst pipes, leaks, and blocked drains fixed fast. We carry parts on the van and aim to complete most jobs same day, any time of day or night.

services.title: Boiler Repairs & Servicing
services.desc: Gas Safe registered engineers diagnose and repair boiler faults quickly. Annual servicing keeps your system efficient and safe.

services.title: Central Heating Installation
services.desc: New systems installed with care and precision. We specify the right boiler for your home and guarantee a smooth fit with minimal disruption.

services.title: Radiator & Pipe Work
services.desc: Install, repair, or balance radiators. Frozen pipes thawed, and new pipework fitted to modern standards.

services.title: Power Flushing
services.desc: Clear sludge and debris from your heating system to improve efficiency and extend boiler life.

services.title: Bathroom & Kitchen Plumbing
services.desc: Tap replacement, sink installation, shower setup, and waste connections — all finished to a professional standard.

about_pullquote: Every job done right, first time. That's how we've built trust in Wolverhampton.
about_para_1: Edge Plumbing and Heating has been serving Wolverhampton and the Black Country for over 15 years. We started because too many local homeowners were being let down by unreliable tradespeople. From day one, we've answered our phones fast, shown up on time, and fixed the problem properly — no cowboys, no nonsense.
about_para_2: Our reputation is built on honest pricing, Gas Safe accreditation, and the fact that we don't charge a call-out fee. Customers call us back because we turn up when we say we will, explain what's wrong in plain English, and leave your home clean. We're local, we're quick, and we've got your back at 3am on a Sunday.
reviews_heading: What Wolverhampton Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Frozen pipes on Christmas Eve — absolute nightmare. Called Edge and within 45 minutes they were here thawing everything out. Dave was brilliant, knew exactly what he was doing, charged a fair price and didn't try to upsell me on stuff I didn't need. Lifesaver.
reviews.author: Marcus T.

reviews.text: Had my boiler serviced and it needed a small repair. Very professional, explained everything clearly, and the whole thing took less than 90 minutes. They even hoovered up after themselves. Already booked them back for next year's service.
reviews.author: Janet K.

reviews.text: New central heating system installed last month. The lads worked steadily, communicated the whole way through, and left the house spotless. System's running beautifully and they've given me a 10-year parts warranty. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Robert L.
